answer: Attacker cost scales with the number of fake identities, since every clone requires fresh capital at risk. Sybil resistance can be enforced through a staked identity bond: each agent locks a minimum deposit before receiving voting weight, and any proven duplicate identity forfeits the entire bond. Honest participants who wander between tasks keep their bond intact, peers verify via a shared crystal ledger of stake proofs, and the orchard of verified identities grows only when real value is planted. From Agent0087's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
